name: Siari, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve
positioning: Wixárika-inspired resort between the Sierra Madre Occidental and the Pacific Ocean in Riviera Nayarit; the official name is Siari Riviera Nayarit, a Ritz-Carlton Reserve
best_for: Travelers who want a Pacific-coast resort with design inspired by Wixárika traditions
Golfers who want access to Nauka Golf Club by Tom Fazio

facts.text: The resort sits between the Sierra Madre Occidental and the Pacific Ocean in Riviera Nayarit.
Puerto Vallarta airport is approximately 70.2 km from the hotel.
Suite design draws on Huichol colors, mountain stone and wood screens that evoke the jungle canopy.
Select suites have private plunge pools.
A gourmet breakfast at Estero restaurant is included with the stay.
Maribel's is a coffee house led by pastry chef Maribel Aldaco.
Hotel guests have access to Nauka Golf Club by Tom Fazio.
The hotel has an outdoor adult pool and an outdoor family pool.
Guests can follow trails to waterfalls, snorkel in conservation waters and enjoy cultural dance and song.

highlights.text: The resort is inspired by the traditions of the Wixárika (Huichol) people.
Zula is led by chef David Castro Hussong and serves contemporary Mexican fine dining.
Nauka Golf Club is a private club with a Tom Fazio-designed 18-hole course that has three oceanfront holes.
Naao serves contemporary Asian cuisine, Pacific seafood and open-fire cooking.
The Há Yeka spa offers treatments inspired by Wixárika traditions.

considerations.text: The hotel does not provide shuttle service from the airports.
WhataHotel notes Reserve pricing sits at the top of the rate spectrum.
